title: deguelia brachyptera
intro: Deguelia brachyptera, commonly known as African Bush Mango, is a plant species in the Leguminosae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Deguelia brachyptera include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of Deguelia brachyptera include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
